facts.fact: Kenya News Agency says the Konza Technopolis Data Center serves government departments, state agencies and private enterprises with cloud services (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS).
Kenya News Agency describes the Konza Technology City data centre as Tier III with a capacity of 1.6 petabytes, without naming who certified it.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT through Konza Technopolis Development Authority
